reportsModule.title: Reports
reportsModule.subtitle: Professional reports on your squad, each athlete, every match, your opponents and the market, ready to share with the coaching staff.

generator.title: Generate report
generator.subtitle: ATHLOS-branded PDF built from real data. When a value is missing the report says so: it is never filled in.
generator.readOnly: Your role can view and download reports, but generating them requires a write role (admin, coach, medical or analyst).
generator.squadWeeklyHelp: GPS load and ACWR per athlete, alerts and team wellness in aggregate only (no individual medical data).
generator.postMatchHelp: Team metrics, events, speeds, players and heat maps from a finished video analysis.
generator.rivalHelp: Profile, scouted roster and, if you pick one of your teams, the match simulation.
generator.monthlyLoadHelp: Four weeks of load: team and per-athlete Player Load week by week, ACWR trend and spikes. No health data.
generator.playerIndividualHelp: Profile, weekly GPS load trend, ACWR, latest sessions with the models' reading, attributes within the squad and competition stats. No wellness, injuries or injury risk.
generator.injuryRiskHelp: Injury risk level and score per athlete with the load the model used, prediction date and the model's real metrics. No wellbeing factors or injury history.
generator.injuryRiskRestricted: Health data: only admins and medical staff can generate it and see it in the history.
generator.seasonSummaryHelp: Competition stats for the team's season, comparison with the conference average, per-player stats and monthly physical volume.
generator.marketHelp: Shortlist from a league loaded in Current market: key per-90 metrics with their percentile within the league and position, and the profile of the top five.

fields.periodEndHint: The report covers the 7 days ending on this date.
fields.noRivals: No opponents yet: add them in the Rivals module
fields.ownTeamHint: Without one of your teams, the report has no simulation.
fields.periodEndOptionalHint: Without a date, the report ends on the last day with GPS data.
fields.noLeagues: No leagues loaded in Current market.
fields.sortMetricHint: Key metrics for the chosen position.
fields.minMinutesHint: Percentiles are only computed from 600 minutes.

history.title: Report history
history.subtitle: Every report in your organization, including the Excel files AthlosBot generates. "Download" saves the file straight to your device.
history.emptyDescription: Generate the first one from the panel above: weekly, monthly load, athlete profile, post-match, season, opponent or market.
history.deleteDescription: The file and its history entry are removed for the whole organization. This cannot be undone.
